description: Germany only. Check a monthly salary and weekly hours against the German statutory minimum wage (Mindestlohn) on a given date: hourly wage, minimum wage, required monthly pay and the shortfall. Uses 13/3 weeks per month like payroll. Not for apprentices (they have a minimum training allowance).
